launch_ecs_instance: launch a new ECS Fargate task instance for the craftassist cluster with a specified world config
check_instance_status: check the progress and public IP of an ECS task instance via the status endpoint
register_cloudflare_subdomain: register a unique proxied DNS subdomain on CloudFlare for a given ECS container IP
check_instance_expired: check if an ECS task instance has expired or is no longer in a running state
run_flask_server: run the Flask WebSocket server with the MephistoRouter blueprint on a configurable port
